name: pandadoc
description: Connect PandaDoc to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use PandaDoc MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect PandaDoc to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with documents, proposals and e-signatures using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my PandaDoc workspace.
Find anything in PandaDoc that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review documents, proposals and e-signatures in PandaDoc.
